name: iplweb-claude-skills
description: Claude Code skills for Python and DevOps workflows

plugins.name: code-review-external
plugins.description: Parallel external code review with codex, opencode, and a Claude subagent — auto-detects target (uncommitted diff, commit, file, or directory), runs all three reviewers concurrently, surfaces three independent opinions side-by-side. Includes individual skills for each reviewer.

plugins.name: github-build-fixer
plugins.description: Diagnoses and fixes failing GitHub Actions CI builds — reads logs, proposes fixes, pushes, polls until green

plugins.name: oss-github-publisher
plugins.description: Pre-flight audit before publishing a repo as open source — checks LICENSE, CI, pre-commit, scans for secrets and PII

plugins.name: premortem
plugins.description: Klein-style premortem on plans, launches, hires, pricing, or strategy — assumes failure 6 months out and works backward to expose blind spots

plugins.name: python-upgrade-package
plugins.description: Modernizes legacy Python packages step-by-step — setup.py to uv + pyproject.toml, Travis to GitHub Actions, pytest migration

plugins.name: readme-guardian
plugins.description: Analyzes and improves Python project READMEs — badges, install instructions, version support matrix
